description: BOM (Bill of Materials) module - Hierarchical product structure tree viewer with drag-and-drop reordering, PL linkage on each node, and product management. Implements the tree builder interface for locomotive assemblies using @dnd-kit for interactive tree manipulation.
steps: Create src/lib/mock-data/bom.ts: Mock BOM data with 2-3 products (e.g., WAP-7 Locomotive, WAG-9 Locomotive). Each product has a tree structure 3-4 levels deep with realistic assemblies (Traction System > Traction Motor > Armature, Bogie Assembly > Frame > Suspension, etc.). Each node has: name, type (assembly/sub_assembly/component), pl_id reference, quantity, unit, material, weight, drawing_ref

Create src/server/routers/bom.ts: BOM tRPC router with procedures: products (list all), getProduct (full tree by product ID), createProduct, addEntry (add node to tree), moveEntry (reorder/reparent via position update), removeEntry, linkPL (link BOM entry to PL number). Uses mock-db service
Create src/lib/validators/bom.ts: Zod schemas for BOM operations (create product, add entry with type validation, move entry)

Create src/app/(protected)/bom/page.tsx: BOM Explorer page. PageFrame with PageHeader ('BOM Explorer', 'New Product' action). List of products as cards (product name, code, version, status, entry count). Click to navigate to product detail

Create src/app/(protected)/bom/[productId]/page.tsx: Product BOM view. Left panel: interactive tree view (collapsible nodes). Right panel: selected node details. Header: product name, version badge, export button. Tree shows: expand/collapse, drag handles, node type icons (assembly=folder, sub_assembly=folder-open, component=circle), PL number badge on each node, quantity display

Create src/components/bom/bom-tree.tsx: Interactive BOM tree component using @dnd-kit/sortable. Each node shows: type icon, name, PL number (if linked), quantity. Supports: expand/collapse, drag-to-reorder within same parent, drag-to-reparent (move between parents). Drop indicators show valid targets. Tree lines connecting nodes

Create src/components/bom/bom-tree-node.tsx: Single tree node component. Renders: indent level, expand arrow (if has children), type icon, name text, PL badge (clickable link to PL detail), quantity badge, action menu (edit, add child, remove, link PL). Drag handle on left. Selected state with highlight

Create src/components/bom/bom-node-detail.tsx: Right panel showing full details of selected BOM node. Fields: name, type, PL number (with search/link), quantity, unit, material, weight, specifications, drawing reference, vendor. Edit inline or via form dialog

Create src/components/bom/add-entry-dialog.tsx: Dialog for adding new BOM entry. Form fields: name, type (assembly/sub_assembly/component), PL number (search input with autocomplete from PL registry), quantity, unit, material, weight, drawing_ref. Parent context shown
Create src/app/(protected)/bom/new/page.tsx: Create Product form. Fields: product_name, product_code (unique), description. After creation redirects to empty product tree view
Create src/hooks/use-bom.ts: Hook wrapping tRPC queries for BOM (products list, product tree, mutations for add/move/remove/link)
Update src/server/routers/_app.ts to include bom router
Update sidebar navigation to include BOM Explorer link
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes
acceptance_criteria: BOM Explorer page lists products with metadata cards
Product view shows hierarchical tree with collapsible nodes
Tree nodes display: type icon, name, PL number badge, quantity
Drag-and-drop reordering works within same parent level
Selected node shows full details in right panel
Add entry dialog validates and creates new nodes in the tree
Each node can be linked to a PL number from the registry
Navigation sidebar includes BOM Explorer link
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
